title: Kolkata hotel fire kills 9 Bangladeshi nationals
summary: The blaze erupted around 2 a.m.; at least 15 others were rescued from the hotel

title: In T.N., Tahsildar suspended for ordering collection of details of Communist party members
summary: M. Ayyasamy, the tahsildar of Guziliamparai in Dindigul district, issued the order on August 18 and directed officials to submit the details by the evening, failing which action would be taken

title: Shadow of price rise looms over Onam Pookkalam
summary: Vendors believe  business may improve once educational institutions close and people fully enter the Onam mood

title: U.S. Ambassador Sergio Gor to visit Kashmir, meet Omar Abdullah
summary: The U.S. Ambassador to India and Special Envoy to South and Central Asia is expected to arrive in Srinagar on August 19 and meet Chief Minister Omar Abdullah, with a visit to Ladakh also likely

title: Former Delhi Minister Satyendar Jain, ex-DJB CEO among six arrested in STP projects tender case
summary: The other accused arrested are Ankit Srivastava, a former contractual consultant with the DJB, and private persons Nagendra Yadav, Raja Kumar Kurra and Pankaj Verma, the ACB said in a statement.

title: Jharkhand Government releases list of 44 recruitment exams cancelled due to irregularities
summary: The cancelled exams include recruitment for drug inspectors, assistant professors, deputy collectors, dental doctors, assistant engineers, civil judges, and additional public prosecutors, among others

title: Goa moves Supreme Court to enhance sentence of Tarun Tejpal in 2013 rape case
summary: The State said the sentence was inadequate but clarified that it did not want to challenge or reopen the findings or conclusions on merit recorded by the Bombay High Court in a judgment on August 6

title: Bengal hotel fire: Two owners held, death toll rises to nine
summary: During an inspection by the Birbhum district administration, at least 15 hotels have been found where fire safety arrangements were not in place. The administration is directed to seal all those hotels
